dialogue.speaker: doom
dialogue.text: Incorrect. Doom is not surprised.

dialogue.speaker: doom
dialogue.text: The answer is wrong. The task is not.

dialogue.speaker: doom
dialogue.text: Doom has heard better guesses from worse minds.

dialogue.speaker: doom
dialogue.text: Wrong. Read the task again.

dialogue.speaker: doombot
dialogue.text: SUBMISSION REJECTED. ATTEMPT LOGGED.

dialogue.speaker: doombot
dialogue.text: NEGATIVE. RECALIBRATE.

dialogue.speaker: doombot
dialogue.text: ANSWER DOES NOT MATCH. SENTRY CHARGE EXPENDED.

dialogue.speaker: doom
dialogue.text: Doom notes the attempt. Doom notes the error.

dialogue.speaker: doom
dialogue.text: Correct. Doom acknowledges the work.

dialogue.speaker: doom
dialogue.text: The answer is right. That cost you something. Doom saw.

dialogue.speaker: doom
dialogue.text: Well done. Doom does not say that often.

dialogue.speaker: doom
dialogue.text: Doom is impressed. Doom is rarely impressed.

dialogue.speaker: doombot
dialogue.text: SUBMISSION ACCEPTED. LOCK RELEASED.

dialogue.speaker: doombot
dialogue.text: AFFIRMATIVE. YOU MAY PROCEED.

dialogue.speaker: doom
dialogue.text: The task has fallen. A better one is waiting.

dialogue.speaker: doom
dialogue.text: Doom will remember this solve.

dialogue.speaker: doombot
dialogue.text: SENTRY LOCKDOWN. ATTEMPTS EXHAUSTED. READING AND HINTS REMAIN AVAILABLE.

dialogue.speaker: doombot
dialogue.text: LOCKDOWN ENGAGED. CONTACT AN ORGANISER TO RESTORE ATTEMPTS.

dialogue.speaker: doom
dialogue.text: Five attempts. Doom granted five. The sentry will not move for a sixth.

dialogue.speaker: doom
dialogue.text: The sentry has closed the door. Doom suggests the applicants think before they knock.

dialogue.speaker: doombot
dialogue.text: ACCESS SUSPENDED. HINT CHANNEL OPEN.

dialogue.speaker: doom
dialogue.text: Another has already broken this lock. Doom is watching the others.

dialogue.speaker: doom
dialogue.text: First blood is drawn. The Registry has recorded it.

dialogue.speaker: doom
dialogue.text: This task has not fallen before. It has now. Doom approves.

dialogue.speaker: doom
dialogue.text: You were first. Doom does not forget the first.

dialogue.speaker: doombot
dialogue.text: FIRST BREACH CONFIRMED. LOGGED IN REGISTRY.

dialogue.speaker: doom
dialogue.text: The region is cleared. Doom has fewer secrets than this morning.

dialogue.speaker: doom
dialogue.text: Every task here has fallen. Doom notes the thoroughness.

dialogue.speaker: doom
dialogue.text: You have emptied this place. Doom will fill it again when it is useful.

dialogue.speaker: doombot
dialogue.text: REGION COMPLETE. SENTRIES STAND DOWN.

dialogue.speaker: doom
dialogue.text: There is nothing left to find here. Doom suggests another region.

dialogue.speaker: doombot
dialogue.text: TASK UNLOCKED. FIVE ATTEMPTS ALLOCATED.

dialogue.speaker: doom
dialogue.text: Read the task. Doom does not write words he does not intend.

dialogue.speaker: doom
dialogue.text: Every task can be solved. This one can be solved by you.

dialogue.speaker: doombot
dialogue.text: PROCEED WITH CAUTION.

dialogue.speaker: doom
dialogue.text: Doom has made this fair. Doom has not made it easy.

dialogue.speaker: doom
dialogue.text: The mask has a history. Doom will tell it. Doom will tell it once.

dialogue.speaker: doom
dialogue.text: The Incursion has begun. Doom will do what must be done.

dialogue.speaker: doom
dialogue.text: The Trial is over. Doom will remember.

dialogue.speaker: doom
dialogue.text: I remember her hands. Doom remembers everything else. I remember her hands.
